title: In der Gruppe
desc: Fourteen people, eighty messages, and one thumb
setting: Your phone on the table at nine in the evening, going off every forty seconds.

steps.speaker: Timo
steps.es: Samstag Grillieren bei mir. Wer kommt?
steps.en: Barbecue at my place on Saturday. Who is coming?

options.en: I will be there. At seven?
options.feedback: Short, and it drops the ich. That is the register for messages and a long sentence reads as a problem.

options.es: Ich komme sehr gern und freue mich schon.
options.en: I am coming very gladly and am already looking forward to it.
options.feedback: Nothing is wrong with it. It is four times longer than every other reply and he will ask if you are all right.
A thumb is a yes. Not I have read this: I am coming. People have been counted absent for the difference.
Two words and it is binding. Nobody will ask again, and the bread had better be there.
Now nobody knows whether there is bread. In a group of fourteen, maybe is worse than no.
Fine. Ask in the group rather than to him alone, and somebody will name a thing.
He is seventy-one, he sends the same picture of flowers every morning at six, and nobody answers. Nobody minds either.
Kind, and now there are two messages where the group expected none. He will be pleased.

options.en: It is six in the morning.
options.feedback: It is. He has been up since half past four and this is what he does with the hour.

steps.speaker: Timo
steps.es: Du warst nicht da. Alles gut?
steps.en: You were not there. Everything all right?

options.es: Es tut mir leid. Ich habe nur den Daumen geschickt.
options.en: I am sorry. I only sent the thumb.
options.feedback: Said on the same day it is nothing. Left for three days it becomes a thing, and Nuno will tell you so.
You sent a thumb. Here that is the yes, and the argument will not go your way.
Fine as far as it goes. Sending that on Friday instead of explaining it on Wednesday is the fix.
